d:
Takshashila naresh ambhiraj ko suchna milti hai ki uska putr aambhikumar alakshendr se sandhi kar use apne rajy men pravesh karne ki anumti de raha hai , pita putr men bhishan bahas hoti hai aur pita ambhiraj apne hi putr aambhikumar ko bandi banane ka aadesh dete hain, magar unke svayan ke sainik unki aagya ka palan nahin karte. phir kya hoga aage dekhiye is bhag men.
Episode 10 Part -2 of a 47-part historical drama Chanakya. An epic Indian television series.
Written and directed by Dr. Chandraprakash Dwivedi.
Produced by
Prakash M Dwivedi.
Starring
Chandraprakash Dwivedi
